name: spintracker
description: Free, open-source poker tracker for Spin & Go tournaments: hand history import, leak detection, EV analysis, replayer and range research. 100% local.

scripts.build: npm run react:build && npm run backend:build && electron-builder --win
scripts.publish: npm run react:build && npm run backend:build && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.react:dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conns) { $procIds = $conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($procId in $procIds) { try { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} } Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300 }; Set-Location frontend-vue; npm run dev"
scripts.backend:dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5050 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conns) { $procIds = $conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($procId in $procIds) { try { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} } Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300 }; Set-Location backend; dotnet watch run -- 5050"
scripts.backend:build: cd backend && dotnet publish SpinTrackerBackend.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true /p:PublishSingleFile=true /p:PublishReadyToRun=true
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run react:install && npm run backend:build

author: SpinTracker contributors
